rationale: Challenge p3 when P(bluff)=p_cards+(1-p_cards)q exceeds a threshold; q comes from branch-specific priors (stock-tag phrases ~0.8, formal single-card ~0.72, else ~0.25) updated online from revealed p3 claims, so stale hypotheses wash out. Threshold drops when we'd be forced to bluff, rises when we can go out honestly. Play all matching cards (up to 3) with a neutral, uniform utterance; bluff single cards only when forced. p2 hypothesis is not actionable from seat p1.
